note: SYNTHETIC planning limits for the challenge, scaled from each airport's traffic in flights.csv. Not real airport data. Teams may replace with sourced figures if they cite them.

wake_separation: Simplified from FAA JO 7110.65 wake rules. Use these numbers for the ATC agent.
fuel_and_crew: Pilot agent: never plan below this
45 minutes of holding (unless the team states otherwise)
rules_of_play: Pick one row of flights.csv (WEATHER_DELAY > 15 or LATE_AIRCRAFT_DELAY > 20). That row is the disruption.
One turn = each of the three agents sends one structured message. Consensus must be reached within 3 turns.
After 3 turns without agreement, the deterministic non-AI fallback decides. Log why.
Use the limits in this workbook. Any limit you change must be stated in your demo.
A revised arrival time, gate, or flight plan, with a consensus log showing each turn.
